common_rules: All memory offsets, lengths and opaque handles retain the generic ABI's i64 values even in Wasm32
Exactly one unshared memory0; reject unsupported memory, overflow, overlap, truncation, epoch, handle or right before native access
External adapter identity is SHA256 of the whole exact strict UTF-8 adapter JSON bytes; policy and Wasm digests remain distinct
Host enforces grants, actual simulator instance, epoch, state freshness and native outcome on every call
Do not reinterpret one family's wire records as another family's commands or observations

supersedes_preview: v0.2.0; planar record kinds and heading representation are deliberately distinct; old records must be refused

heading_representation.meaning: Exact integer angular grid;6283186 ticks is one full turn. This is not a claim that2*pi equals6.283186 radians.
heading_representation.native_conversion: Adapter rounds normalized native yaw/(2*pi)*6283186 with a pinned tie rule, and converts tolerances externally. Host validates native pose before quantization.
heading_representation.boundary: Both signed half-turn endpoints represent the same heading; guest computes min(abs(delta),6283186-abs(delta)).
